glossary_terms.name: Active Customers
glossary_terms.short_description: COUNT(DISTINCT Customer) with at least one sale in the period.

glossary_terms.name: Average Ticket
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Net Paid) / COUNT(DISTINCT Ticket Number or Order Number).

glossary_terms.name: Bill-To Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: On catalog and web orders, the customer who was billed for the order.
glossary_terms.long_description: May differ from the Ship-To Customer (gifts, business orders).

glossary_terms.name: Birth Country
glossary_terms.short_description: Country in which the customer was born.

glossary_terms.name: Birth Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Customer date of birth, stored as separate day, month and year parts.

glossary_terms.name: Brand
glossary_terms.short_description: Brand of the item.

glossary_terms.name: Business Key
glossary_terms.short_description: Stable, human-readable identifier for a dimension member that survives Type-2 history changes.
glossary_terms.long_description: Columns ending in _id (16-character string). Several surrogate keys can share one business key when the entity has history.

glossary_terms.name: Buy Potential
glossary_terms.short_description: Estimated household annual spending band.

glossary_terms.name: Calendar Date
glossary_terms.short_description: One row per calendar day with fiscal and calendar attributes.
glossary_terms.long_description: All facts reference dates by surrogate key. Sales use the sold date; returns use the returned date; catalog/web also carry a ship date. Also known as: Date, Day.

glossary_terms.name: Calendar Year
glossary_terms.short_description: Calendar year of the date.

glossary_terms.name: Call Center
glossary_terms.short_description: A facility that takes catalog orders and returns by phone. Type-2.

glossary_terms.name: Call Center Attributes
glossary_terms.short_description: Name, class, size, hours and manager of a call center.

glossary_terms.name: Carrier
glossary_terms.short_description: Shipping company used.

glossary_terms.name: Catalog Page
glossary_terms.short_description: A page in a printed catalog from which an item was ordered.

glossary_terms.name: Catalog Page Attributes
glossary_terms.short_description: Catalog number, page number, department, type and validity dates.

glossary_terms.name: Category
glossary_terms.short_description: Top level of the product hierarchy.

glossary_terms.name: Class
glossary_terms.short_description: Second level of the product hierarchy, within a Category.

glossary_terms.name: College Dependent Count
glossary_terms.short_description: Number of dependents attending college.

glossary_terms.name: Company
glossary_terms.short_description: Legal company an operating unit belongs to.

glossary_terms.name: Coupon Amount
glossary_terms.short_description: Coupon discount applied to the line, after the sales price.

glossary_terms.name: Credit Rating
glossary_terms.short_description: Credit risk classification of the customer.

glossary_terms.name: Current Period Flags
glossary_terms.short_description: Flags marking the current day, week, month, quarter and year.

glossary_terms.name: Current Price
glossary_terms.short_description: Current list price of the item version.

glossary_terms.name: Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: A person who has purchased from any channel.
glossary_terms.long_description: One row per customer. Links to current demographics and address; historical demographics at time of sale are on the fact rows. Also known as: Shopper, Buyer.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Address
glossary_terms.short_description: Postal address; used for the customer's current address and for the address on each sale.
glossary_terms.long_description: Fact rows reference the address used at time of sale, which may differ from the customer's current address.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Demographics
glossary_terms.short_description: Personal demographic profile: gender, marital status, education, credit rating, dependents.
glossary_terms.long_description: A shared lookup; many customers map to the same demographic row. Fact rows carry the demographics in effect at time of sale.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Email
glossary_terms.short_description: Customer email address.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Login
glossary_terms.short_description: Customer web login name.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Name
glossary_terms.short_description: Salutation, first and last name of the customer.

glossary_terms.name: Day of Week
glossary_terms.short_description: Day of week number and name.

glossary_terms.name: Dependent Count
glossary_terms.short_description: Number of dependents in the customer's household.

glossary_terms.name: Dimension
glossary_terms.short_description: A descriptive entity used to slice facts: who, what, where, when.

glossary_terms.name: Discount Active
glossary_terms.short_description: Whether the promotion's discount was in effect.

glossary_terms.name: Discount Rate
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Extended Discount Amount + Coupon Amount) / SUM(Extended List Price).

glossary_terms.name: Division
glossary_terms.short_description: Organizational division an operating unit belongs to.

glossary_terms.name: Education Status
glossary_terms.short_description: Highest education level attained.

glossary_terms.name: Employed Dependent Count
glossary_terms.short_description: Number of dependents who are employed.

glossary_terms.name: Extended Discount Amount
glossary_terms.short_description: Quantity Sold x (Unit List Price - Unit Sales Price). Markdown from list.
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Markdown.

glossary_terms.name: Extended List Price
glossary_terms.short_description: Quantity Sold x Unit List Price.

glossary_terms.name: Extended Sales Price
glossary_terms.short_description: Quantity Sold x Unit Sales Price. Gross line revenue before coupons and tax.
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Gross Sales.

glossary_terms.name: Extended Ship Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Shipping charge on a catalog or web line.

glossary_terms.name: Extended Tax
glossary_terms.short_description: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on Net Paid.

glossary_terms.name: Extended Wholesale Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Quantity Sold x Unit Wholesale Cost.
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: COGS Line.

glossary_terms.name: First Sale Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date of the customer's first purchase in any channel.

glossary_terms.name: First Ship-To Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date of the first order shipped to the customer.

glossary_terms.name: Fiscal Year
glossary_terms.short_description: Fiscal year of the date.

glossary_terms.name: GMT Offset
glossary_terms.short_description: Time-zone offset from GMT, in hours, for a location.

glossary_terms.name: Gender
glossary_terms.short_description: Customer gender.

glossary_terms.name: Geography
glossary_terms.short_description: City, county, state, zip and country attributes shared by all address-bearing entities.

glossary_terms.name: Gross Margin
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Net Profit) / SUM(Net Paid). Profit as a share of net revenue.

glossary_terms.name: Gross Margin Amount
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Net Profit).

glossary_terms.name: Holiday
glossary_terms.short_description: Whether the date is a holiday, and whether it follows one.

glossary_terms.name: Household Demographics
glossary_terms.short_description: Household-level profile: income band, buying potential, dependents, vehicles.

glossary_terms.name: Income Band
glossary_terms.short_description: Household annual income range with lower and upper bound.

glossary_terms.name: Inventory
glossary_terms.short_description: Weekly snapshot of units on hand per item per warehouse.
glossary_terms.long_description: Semi-additive: sum across items and warehouses, never across dates.

glossary_terms.name: Item
glossary_terms.short_description: A product the retailer sells. Type-2: price and attributes are versioned over time.
glossary_terms.long_description: Join facts on i_item_sk to get the item version in effect at the time of sale; use i_item_id to group across versions. Also known as: Product, SKU.

glossary_terms.name: Item Attributes
glossary_terms.short_description: Physical attributes: size, color, units, container, formulation.

glossary_terms.name: Item Wholesale Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Standard per-unit cost the retailer pays for the item.

glossary_terms.name: Last Review Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date the customer record was last reviewed.

glossary_terms.name: Location Type
glossary_terms.short_description: Type of dwelling at the address.

glossary_terms.name: Manufacturer
glossary_terms.short_description: Manufacturer of the item.

glossary_terms.name: Marital Status
glossary_terms.short_description: Customer marital status code.

glossary_terms.name: Market
glossary_terms.short_description: Marketing region an operating unit belongs to.

glossary_terms.name: Meal Time
glossary_terms.short_description: Meal period in which the time falls.

glossary_terms.name: Month
glossary_terms.short_description: Month of year and a monotonically increasing month sequence used for period arithmetic.

glossary_terms.name: Net Loss
glossary_terms.short_description: Total loss to the retailer from the return. Verify exact formula against dsdgen pricing.c before governing.
glossary_terms.long_description: Derived by dsdgen from return amount including tax, fee and shipping cost, net of the refund components. Treat as a measure, not a definition, until verified.

glossary_terms.name: Net Paid
glossary_terms.short_description: Extended Sales Price - Coupon Amount. Revenue the customer actually paid, before tax and shipping.
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Net Sales, Net Revenue.

glossary_terms.name: Net Paid Including Ship
glossary_terms.short_description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost (catalog and web only).

glossary_terms.name: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax
glossary_terms.short_description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost + Extended Tax (catalog and web only).

glossary_terms.name: Net Paid Including Tax
glossary_terms.short_description: Net Paid + Extended Tax.

glossary_terms.name: Net Profit
glossary_terms.short_description: Net Paid - Extended Wholesale Cost. Line-level gross profit.
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Gross Profit.

glossary_terms.name: Net Sales After Returns
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Net Paid) - SUM(Return Amount).
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Net Net Sales.

glossary_terms.name: Order Number
glossary_terms.short_description: Identifier of a catalog or web order; groups the line items of one order.
glossary_terms.long_description: Natural key of a line is (order number, item).

glossary_terms.name: Preferred Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: Flag marking customers enrolled in the preferred/loyalty program.

glossary_terms.name: Product Manager
glossary_terms.short_description: Identifier of the manager responsible for the item.

glossary_terms.name: Product Name
glossary_terms.short_description: Display name of the item.

glossary_terms.name: Promotion
glossary_terms.short_description: A marketing campaign offering a discount on an item over a date range.

glossary_terms.name: Promotion Channel
glossary_terms.short_description: Marketing channels through which the promotion was communicated (Y/N flags).

glossary_terms.name: Promotion Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Amount spent to run the promotion.

glossary_terms.name: Promotion Lift
glossary_terms.short_description: Net Paid on lines with a promotion vs lines without, for the same item and period.

glossary_terms.name: Promotion Period
glossary_terms.short_description: Start and end dates of the promotion.

glossary_terms.name: Promotion Purpose
glossary_terms.short_description: Business purpose and response target of the promotion.

glossary_terms.name: Purchase Estimate
glossary_terms.short_description: Estimated annual purchase amount band for the customer, in whole currency units.

glossary_terms.name: Quantity On Hand
glossary_terms.short_description: Units of the item held at the warehouse on the snapshot date.

glossary_terms.name: Quantity Sold
glossary_terms.short_description: Number of units of the item on the sales line.

glossary_terms.name: Quarter
glossary_terms.short_description: Calendar quarter (1-4) and quarter name.

glossary_terms.name: Refunded Cash
glossary_terms.short_description: Portion of the refund paid in cash.

glossary_terms.name: Refunded Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: On catalog and web returns, the customer who received the refund (the original buyer).

glossary_terms.name: Return Amount
glossary_terms.short_description: Value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax.

glossary_terms.name: Return Amount Including Tax
glossary_terms.short_description: Return Amount + Return Tax.

glossary_terms.name: Return Fee
glossary_terms.short_description: Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for the return.

glossary_terms.name: Return Measure
glossary_terms.short_description: A numeric fact recorded on a return transaction line.

glossary_terms.name: Return Quantity
glossary_terms.short_description: Units returned on the line.

glossary_terms.name: Return Quantity Rate
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Return Quantity) / SUM(Quantity Sold).

glossary_terms.name: Return Rate
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Return Amount) / SUM(Net Paid) for the same channel and period.

glossary_terms.name: Return Reason
glossary_terms.short_description: Reason code given by the customer for a return.

glossary_terms.name: Return Ship Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Shipping cost incurred to return the goods.

glossary_terms.name: Return Tax
glossary_terms.short_description: Tax refunded on the return.

glossary_terms.name: Return Transaction
glossary_terms.short_description: A line item recording a customer returning a quantity of one item previously sold.
glossary_terms.long_description: Returns reference the original sale via Ticket Number or Order Number plus Item. Not every sale has a return. Also known as: Return, Merchandise Return.

glossary_terms.name: Returned Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date the return was processed.

glossary_terms.name: Returning Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: On catalog and web returns, the customer who physically returned the goods.

glossary_terms.name: Reversed Charge
glossary_terms.short_description: Portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge.

glossary_terms.name: Sales Channel
glossary_terms.short_description: One of the three ways the retailer sells goods: physical store, printed catalog, or web site.
glossary_terms.long_description: Every sales and returns fact table belongs to exactly one channel. Channel is implied by the table, not stored as a column.

glossary_terms.name: Sales Measure
glossary_terms.short_description: A numeric fact recorded on a sales transaction line.

glossary_terms.name: Sales Transaction
glossary_terms.short_description: A line item recording the sale of a quantity of one item to one customer on one date.
glossary_terms.long_description: One row per item per ticket/order. Store sales are grouped by Ticket Number; catalog and web sales by Order Number. Also known as: Sale, Sales Line.

glossary_terms.name: Same Day Last Year
glossary_terms.short_description: Surrogate key of the equivalent day one year / one quarter earlier, for period-over-period comparison.

glossary_terms.name: Shift
glossary_terms.short_description: Work shift in which the time falls.

glossary_terms.name: Ship Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date a catalog or web order was shipped.

glossary_terms.name: Ship Mode
glossary_terms.short_description: Shipping service level and carrier used for a catalog or web order.

glossary_terms.name: Ship Mode Type
glossary_terms.short_description: Service level of the shipment.

glossary_terms.name: Ship-To Customer
glossary_terms.short_description: On catalog and web orders, the customer the goods were shipped to.

glossary_terms.name: Slowly Changing Dimension
glossary_terms.short_description: A dimension that keeps history: each version is a separate row with a record start and end date.
glossary_terms.long_description: Item, Store, Call Center, Web Site and Web Page are Type-2. Current version has a null record end date.

glossary_terms.name: Sold Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date the sale was made.

glossary_terms.name: Store
glossary_terms.short_description: A physical retail location. Type-2.

glossary_terms.name: Store Closed Date
glossary_terms.short_description: Date the store closed; null while open.

glossary_terms.name: Store Credit
glossary_terms.short_description: Portion of the refund issued as store or account credit.

glossary_terms.name: Store Hours
glossary_terms.short_description: Operating hours description.

glossary_terms.name: Store Manager
glossary_terms.short_description: Name of the store manager.

glossary_terms.name: Store Name
glossary_terms.short_description: Name of the store.

glossary_terms.name: Store Size
glossary_terms.short_description: Floor space in square feet and number of employees.

glossary_terms.name: Surrogate Key
glossary_terms.short_description: System-generated integer identifier used to join fact tables to dimension tables.
glossary_terms.long_description: Columns ending in _sk. Never meaningful to the business; use the corresponding Business Key (_id) for reporting.

glossary_terms.name: Tax Percentage
glossary_terms.short_description: Sales tax rate applied at a store, call center or web site.

glossary_terms.name: Ticket Number
glossary_terms.short_description: Identifier of a store sales receipt; groups the line items of one store visit.
glossary_terms.long_description: Not unique on its own: the natural key of a store sales line is (ticket number, item).

glossary_terms.name: Time of Day
glossary_terms.short_description: One row per second of the day with hour, minute, shift and meal-time attributes.

glossary_terms.name: Total Net Sales
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Net Paid) across the selected channel(s).
glossary_terms.long_description: Also known as: Revenue.

glossary_terms.name: Unit List Price
glossary_terms.short_description: Per-unit list (undiscounted) price at time of sale.

glossary_terms.name: Unit Sales Price
glossary_terms.short_description: Per-unit price actually charged before coupons.

glossary_terms.name: Unit Wholesale Cost
glossary_terms.short_description: Per-unit cost to the retailer at time of sale.

glossary_terms.name: Units Per Transaction
glossary_terms.short_description: SUM(Quantity Sold) / COUNT(DISTINCT Ticket Number or Order Number).

glossary_terms.name: Vehicle Count
glossary_terms.short_description: Number of vehicles in the household.

glossary_terms.name: Warehouse
glossary_terms.short_description: A distribution facility that holds inventory and ships catalog and web orders.

glossary_terms.name: Web Page
glossary_terms.short_description: A specific page on a web site from which an order or return originated. Type-2.

glossary_terms.name: Web Page Attributes
glossary_terms.short_description: URL, type, content counts and creation/access dates of a web page.

glossary_terms.name: Web Site
glossary_terms.short_description: A retailer web property through which orders are placed. Type-2.

glossary_terms.name: Web Site Attributes
glossary_terms.short_description: Name, class, manager and open/close dates of a web site.

glossary_terms.name: Week
glossary_terms.short_description: Monotonically increasing week sequence.

glossary_terms.name: Weekend
glossary_terms.short_description: Whether the date falls on a weekend.

glossary_terms.name: Weeks of Supply
glossary_terms.short_description: Quantity On Hand / average weekly Quantity Sold for the item.
